issue.title: Bring sase bead search --format compact in line with list's new type column
issue.description:
sase bead list's compact rendering now leads each row with an aligned, colored type indicator (see plan
sase/repos/plans/202607/bead_list_type_indicator.md). `sase bead search --format compact` was left out of that
change on purpose: it is Rust-owned (crates/sase_core/src/bead/cli.rs render_search_compact); Python's
_render_search_compact in src/sase/bead/cli_query.py is only a fallback, so the change would have needed a
cross-repo edit to land the CLI-only tale cleanly.

Follow-up: add the same type column to Rust's render_search_compact (and to the Python fallback) so
`sase bead search --format compact` and `sase bead list` stay visually consistent.
